_comment: Five held-out families, chosen because every family here has all three simulation inputs present in the Zenodo sim/ archive (root_sequences, trees_newick, empirical_msas). This is the list behind the 'Running from a checkpoint, end to end' recipe in installation.md, which states it was run 'on five held-out families'. PREVIOUSLY this file listed 20 in-family + 5 held-out families sampled from the paper's family split (seed 42); the 20 in-family entries have no simulation inputs -- training families were never given a re-rooted tree, a root sequence or an empirical MSA -- so benchmarks/generate_all_results.py died on the first one with FileNotFoundError. Rate matrices fit on five families are not the published ones; omit --families_path for the full 14,498 / 553 split.
